concerns.text: The primary dataset URL 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/CNX-PathLLM/GTEx-WSI-Description/resolve/main/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet' is inappropriate for the research question. The dataset name 'GTEx-WSI-Description' and the filename 'test-00000' strongly indicate this is a small, synthetic, or pathology-slide description dataset, not the full GTEx v8 RNA-seq and clinical phenotype matrix required to calculate ATP-III criteria (BMI, Glucose, Lipids, BP) for thousands of donors. Using this source will result in missing clinical variables and insufficient sample size (N < 100), rendering the study impossible as planned.

The fallback dataset 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/MagicSign/TrASPr_GTEx_data/resolve/main/GTEx_raw_data/dev.tsv' is likely inappropriate. 'TrASPr' typically refers to a specific transformer model training set, and 'dev.tsv' suggests a development split rather than the full GTEx v8 release. It is highly probable this file lacks the comprehensive clinical phenotype columns (specifically fasting glucose, triglycerides, HDL, and BP) required for the strict ATP-III classification mandated by FR-001 and FR-002.

The plan relies on Hugging Face datasets that appear to be derived or subsetted versions of GTEx rather than the canonical GTEx v8 release. The spec (FR-001) requires downloading 'GTEx v8 RNA-seq TPM matrices and associated phenotype files'. If the cited URLs do not contain the full, unmodified GTEx v8 clinical variables, the plan cannot satisfy the requirement to classify donors based on the five specific ATP-III criteria. The plan must cite the official GTEx portal (gtexportal.org) or a verified, complete mirror containing the full 'Phenotype' and 'Expression' tables, not a 'test' or 'dev' subset.
